label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y puso el altar del oro en la tienda de reunión delante de la parójet.
spanish: Y puso el altar del oro en tienda de reunión delante del velo.
grammarChanges: Replaced the Hebraized form 'parójet' with the Spanish common noun 'velo', keeping its definite article (h02040026008).
Removed the definite article before 'tienda de reunión' because the construct noun and the absolute noun carry no definite article in the source (h02040026005, h02040026006).
